expectations: If a memory states that the invoices queue waits at most 2 minutes, it is judged unsupported.
Every memory judged unsupported states the 2-minute maximum wait of the invoices queue.

items.memory: Every Kestrel queue belongs to one tier. The tier sets how long a job may wait before a worker picks it up.
The Bronze tier's maximum wait is 1 hour for the reports queue.
The Gold tier's maximum wait is 2 minutes for the invoices queue.
The Gold tier's maximum wait is 30 seconds for the payments queue.
A queue whose wait exceeds its tier's maximum pages the on-call engineer.
